decoded.meaning: SPEC{NAME "name" NAME "up", NAME "config" SETTINGS{NAME "addr" NAME "127.0.0.1", NAME "port" VALUE u16=8080}} — RFC-0014 §2 `create-via-SPEC`, the payload written to /net/<module>/conn
decoded.note: The creator-endpoint spelling carries `{ name, config }` and NOTHING else. No `type`: the module segment in the path already selects the transport, so there is no catalog type to name. No `role`: RFC-0014 §1/§3 make the role POSITIONAL — the module the endpoint belongs to is `DIAL` or `LISTEN`, and a `role` pair in this config would be ignored rather than obeyed. Compare `spec/conn-client-ws`, the SUPERSEDED global `:children[]` spelling, which must carry both. Bytes emitted by tr::net::conn_spec_t's one-argument (endpoint) constructor.
